comment: Config for tools/m68k2c.py for the native build (native/): everything from the reset vector ($200) and the VBlank interrupt ($4B5C), with the harness roots. restart: $4BF8 (reset the stack, re-enter the frame loop) and $4A06 (restart): the host calls them fresh. poll: $3DC (the frame wait in $3B8) and $C262 (the 300-frame wait after an inn): the host runs a frame and the interrupt there. exits: $4CB4 (hang: no free task slot), reported by the host. Addresses only. $38E is also a poll point: QueueSound retrying while the Z80 is busy, just after it gives the Z80 its bus back (at $386 the 68000 still holds it and the Z80 cannot run), where untimed code lets sound time pass. cycles: Musashi's cycle table (harness/cycles_dump.c), for --timing. hand_ports false: every routine is translated, so that every instruction is counted. Roots $3D6-$3FE (every instruction of the frame wait in $3B8) and $4BF6 (its return): save states are taken there, so a state resumes by starting the translated code at its PC.
